transcript.text: Good evening, everyone. I'd like to get our pre-opening routine underway for the Saturday premiere screening. As we've established, the premiere is scheduled for Saturday evening at the Riverside Courtyard, with Harbor Hall available as our alternate venue. Before I can record the operating plan and approve audience admission, I need to hear final status reports from each department in turn. Could we please start with production, then insurance, and then talent coordination? Once I've received all three reports, I'll finalize and approve the plan.
